$comment: Shard definitions for the Stryker matrix in .github/workflows/test-quality.yml. Read by that workflow (`toJSON(fromJSON(...))`) and never by Stryker itself, so it stays out of stryker.config.json (which warns on unknown keys). Balanced longest-processing-time-first by per-file mutant count (via @stryker-mutator/instrumenter) so the shards finish together; regenerate this file if src/lib changes materially.
